title: WebGPU Explained: How AI Can Run Inside a Browser
headline:
AI inside
a browser tab?
meaning: WebGPU exposes GPU computation to web applications.
example: A supported model can process data on your device.
comparison: A webpage can use local hardware, not only a cloud server.
caution: Support, model downloads and app design still matter.
question: Which browser task would you run locally?
lines: An A I tool in a browser does not always need to send every calculation to a remote server.
Web G P U lets supported web applications use graphics hardware for computation, as well as graphics.
That can help a suitable model process data directly on your device, inside a browser tab.
Local processing can reduce network dependence, but it still uses your device memory, power, and compute.
Not every browser, model, or feature supports the same setup. A model download may be needed first.
